title: Published flat rates by weight and size

body: Published flat rates (SGD, before GST): 1 kg / 60 cm $22 · 5 kg / 80 cm $24 · 8 kg / 100 cm $26 · 10 kg / 120 cm $28 · 15 kg / 140 cm $30 · 20 kg / 160 cm $33 · 25 kg / 200 cm $36.
